summary.headline: Judging the Father’s Fortune
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging the parents’ condition and fortune in diurnal and nocturnal nativities, using the Sun, Saturn, the part of the father, triplicity lords, directions, rays, fortunes, and malefics. Conjunctions with benefics indicate paternal prosperity, while malefic contacts indicate infirmity, danger, and financial outcomes.
